loaded_job_pid_matches now requires launchctl print's top-level path to equal the selected plist, program to equal the process path, the loaded arguments to contain the selected script, and the PID to match. MCP and the CLI default pass through an allowlist of fixed error texts (disabled, no targets, busy, invalid settings, osquery missing) that contain no identifiers; other errors stay replaced. The CLI default prints only the number of omitted warnings to stderr.
